revisions.text: Don't get too attached to me. I'm like a wandering protagonist on an episodic TV show. I go where I'm needed the most.

Do you think I brought enough books? I mean, it's probably enough, but I remember this one time I planned on it being an Austen day, but life was like, sorry, lady, it's Bronte time, and I was just, God, I was not prepared.
